h6-babude.ch: 老板让我明天休息？我__呢！
h6-babude.en: The boss is giving me tomorrow off? I couldn't be happier!
h6-babude.why: 巴不得 is for something you'd be glad to see happen — and here it's on offer.

h6-babude.en: He can't wait for the holidays to start.
h6-babude.why: 巴不得 comes right after the person, before what they want to happen.

h6-babude.ch: 他们都很巴不得马上下班。
h6-babude.fix: 他们都巴不得马上下班。
h6-babude.en: They're all dying to knock off right now.
h6-babude.why: 巴不得 already means "badly want", so it takes no 很.

h6-babude.ch: 你不想让我去？我还巴不得不去呢！
h6-babude.en: You don't want me to go? I'd much rather not go anyway!
h6-babude.why: 巴不得 can answer someone who thinks you'll mind: you're actually glad.

h6-babude.en: Everyone is dying for this meeting to be over.
h6-babude.why: 巴不得 goes after the person and before the whole wish.

h6-ba-fangzai-yanli.ch: 他觉得自己最聪明，从来不__别人放在眼里。
h6-ba-fangzai-yanli.en: He thinks he's the cleverest and never takes anyone else seriously.
h6-ba-fangzai-yanli.why: The person you ignore goes between 把 and 放在眼里.

h6-ba-fangzai-yanli.en: She didn't give a little problem like this a second thought.
h6-ba-fangzai-yanli.why: 没 / 不 + 把 + thing + 放在眼里 — the thing sits in the middle.

h6-ba-fangzai-yanli.ch: 他不放在眼里老师的话。
h6-ba-fangzai-yanli.fix: 他不把老师的话放在眼里。
h6-ba-fangzai-yanli.en: He doesn't take the teacher's words seriously.
h6-ba-fangzai-yanli.why: The thing being ignored goes between 把 and 放, not after 眼里.

h6-ba-fangzai-yanli.ch: 那家公司太大了，根本不把我们小公司放在眼里。
h6-ba-fangzai-yanli.en: That company is so big it doesn't take a small firm like ours seriously at all.
h6-ba-fangzai-yanli.why: 不把 + who + 放在眼里 is the normal order, and it's negative as usual.

h6-ba-fangzai-yanli.en: He doesn't care what other people think.
h6-ba-fangzai-yanli.why: 把 comes after 不 and right before the person or thing ignored.

h6-benzhe.ch: 我们__认真负责的态度，把每件事情做好。
h6-benzhe.en: We do every job well, with a serious and responsible attitude.
h6-benzhe.why: An attitude you act in takes 本着; 根据 and 按照 go with facts and rules.

h6-benzhe.en: He does business on the principle of honesty.
h6-benzhe.why: 本着 + principle comes before the action it guides.

h6-benzhe.ch: 本着医生的建议，我每天按时吃药。
h6-benzhe.fix: 按照医生的建议，我每天按时吃药。
h6-benzhe.en: Following the doctor's advice, I take my medicine on time every day.
h6-benzhe.why: Following advice step by step is 按照; 本着 goes with principles and attitudes.

h6-benzhe.ch: 本着节约的原则，这次会议不送礼物。
h6-benzhe.en: In the spirit of saving money, there are no gifts at this meeting.
h6-benzhe.why: 本着 + 原则 names the principle behind the decision.

h6-benzhe.en: We'll do the work well, out of responsibility to everyone.
h6-benzhe.why: 本着 comes after 会 and right before the attitude.

h6-bianyu.ch: 这里离地铁站很近，交通很__。
h6-bianyu.en: It's close to the metro station, so getting around is easy.
h6-bianyu.why: No verb follows, so use the plain adjective 方便; 便于 needs a verb after it.

h6-bianyu.en: The menu has pictures, making it easy for customers to choose.
h6-bianyu.why: The arrangement comes first; 便于 + who + verb says what it makes easy.

h6-bianyu.ch: 这个地方买东西很便于。
h6-bianyu.fix: 这个地方买东西很方便。
h6-bianyu.en: It's very convenient to shop here.
h6-bianyu.why: 便于 can't end a sentence; for plain "convenient" use 方便.

h6-bianyu.ch: 我把日期写在门上，便于大家记得。
h6-bianyu.en: I wrote the date on the door so it's easy for everyone to remember.
h6-bianyu.why: The second clause starts with 便于 + verb: "so that it's easier to …".

h6-bianyu.en: The school sends the notice to every parent so they can easily keep up.
h6-bianyu.why: 便于 opens the second clause, right before who does the verb.

h6-bieshuo.ch: 这个问题连老师都不会，__我们了。
h6-bieshuo.en: Even the teacher can't do this, let alone us.
h6-bieshuo.why: 别说 … 了 at the end means "let alone".

h6-bieshuo.en: Forget a week — I can't wait even one day.
h6-bieshuo.why: 别说 takes the obvious case first; 就是 … 也 gives the surprising one.

h6-bieshuo.ch: 别说小孩子，连大人也看得懂这本书。
h6-bieshuo.fix: 别说大人，连小孩子也看得懂这本书。
h6-bieshuo.en: Never mind adults — even kids can understand this book.
h6-bieshuo.why: The obvious case (adults) goes after 别说; the surprising one (kids) takes 连.

h6-bieshuo.ch: 这里冬天冷得要命，别说游泳了，连出门都难。
h6-bieshuo.en: Winters here are bitterly cold — never mind swimming, even going out is hard.
h6-bieshuo.why: Swimming is the obvious case after 别说; 连 … 都 gives the extreme one.

h6-bieshuo.en: I don't even have a hundred yuan, let alone a thousand.
h6-bieshuo.why: Turned round, 别说 A 了 comes at the end.

h6-bieti-duo-le.ch: 听说儿子找到了好工作，妈妈别提多__了。
h6-bieti-duo-le.en: When she heard her son had found a good job, his mum was over the moon.
h6-bieti-duo-le.why: 多 already does the "how" job, so no 很 or 非常.

h6-bieti-duo-le.en: The new sofa is so comfortable, you can't imagine.
h6-bieti-duo-le.why: 别提 + 多 + adjective + 了 closes the sentence.

h6-bieti-duo-le.ch: 那天的天气别提多很热了。
h6-bieti-duo-le.fix: 那天的天气别提多热了。
h6-bieti-duo-le.en: You can't imagine how hot it was that day.
h6-bieti-duo-le.why: 多 already means "how", so drop 很.

h6-bieti-duo-le.ch: 一个人在北京过年，别提多难受了。
h6-bieti-duo-le.en: Spending New Year alone in Beijing — you can't imagine how hard it was.
h6-bieti-duo-le.why: It works for bad feelings too: 别提多难受了.

h6-bieti-duo-le.en: You can't imagine how much fun this trip was!
h6-bieti-duo-le.why: 别提 comes right before 多 + adjective.

h6-bingfei.ch: 成绩好的学生__都能找到好工作。
h6-bingfei.en: Students with good grades don't all find good jobs.
h6-bingfei.why: 并非 means "actually isn't" — the written 并不是.

h6-bingfei.en: It's not because of the rain that I'm not going.
h6-bingfei.why: 并非 goes before the part being denied.

h6-bingfei.ch: 这个问题并非是很复杂。
h6-bingfei.fix: 这个问题并不是很复杂。
h6-bingfei.en: This problem isn't really that complicated.
h6-bingfei.why: 非 already means 不是, so don't add another 是.

h6-bingfei.ch: 说起来容易的事情，做起来并非都容易。
h6-bingfei.en: Things that are easy to talk about aren't always easy to do.
h6-bingfei.why: 并非 corrects what you might expect: it isn't so.

h6-bingfei.en: Not everything he says is true.
h6-bingfei.why: 并非 goes before 都 to say "not all".

h6-bucheng.ch: 已经十一点了，难道你还要看电视__？
h6-bucheng.en: It's eleven already — don't tell me you're going to keep watching TV?
h6-bucheng.why: 难道 … 不成 closes a sharp "surely not?" question.

h6-bucheng.en: Surely you don't expect me to finish it all on my own?
h6-bucheng.why: 难道 opens the question and 不成 closes it.
不成 already ends the question, so no 吗.

h6-bucheng.ch: 天气冷得要命，难道你还想出去不成？
h6-bucheng.en: It's freezing — don't tell me you still want to go out?
h6-bucheng.why: 难道 … 不成 shows you think the idea is unreasonable.

h6-bucheng.en: Surely you can't eat all these dishes by yourself?
h6-bucheng.why: 不成 sits at the very end, where 吗 would go.

h6-bufang.ch: 这家饭店很有名，你来北京的时候__去尝尝。
h6-bufang.en: This restaurant is famous — why not try it when you come to Beijing?
h6-bufang.why: 不妨 gently suggests trying something; there's no harm in it.

h6-bufang.en: Why not try again a different way?
h6-bufang.why: 不妨 goes before the verb it suggests.

h6-bufang.ch: 上个周末我不妨去了一趟博物馆。
h6-bufang.fix: 这个周末你不妨去一趟博物馆。
h6-bufang.en: Why not go to the museum this weekend?
h6-bufang.why: 不妨 suggests something still to do; it can't report the past.

h6-bufang.ch: 我们反正不着急，不妨走路回去。
h6-bufang.en: We're in no hurry anyway — we might as well walk back.
h6-bufang.why: 不妨 offers an idea: there's no harm in walking.

h6-bufang.en: This book is really interesting — why not have a look?
h6-bufang.why: 不妨 goes after the person and before the verb.

h6-bujin.ch: 看到孩子第一次走路，妈妈__笑了起来。
h6-bujin.en: Seeing her child walk for the first time, the mother couldn't help laughing.
h6-bujin.why: 不禁 is a reaction that comes out before you can stop it.

h6-bujin.en: Walking into the old park, he couldn't help thinking of his grandfather.
h6-bujin.why: What sets off the feeling comes first; 不禁 goes before the reaction.
tpy: zǒu jìn zhè ge lǎo gōng yuán

h6-bujin.ch: 听了这个故事，她不禁不哭了。
h6-bujin.fix: 听了这个故事，她不禁哭了。
h6-bujin.en: Hearing the story, she couldn't help crying.
h6-bujin.why: 不禁 already means "couldn't hold back", so no second 不.

h6-bujin.ch: 天上下着大雪，我不禁想起了家乡。
h6-bujin.en: With heavy snow falling, I couldn't help thinking of home.
h6-bujin.why: Remembering is a reaction, so 不禁 fits.

h6-bujin.en: Hearing the news, everyone cried out.
h6-bujin.why: 不禁 goes after the person and right before the reaction.

h6-buliao.ch: 我本来打算周末去爬山，__周末一直在下雨。
h6-buliao.en: I'd planned to go hiking at the weekend, but it rained the whole time.
h6-buliao.why: 不料 opens the clause where things turn out differently from the plan.

h6-buliao.en: We'd only just got to the park when it started to rain.
h6-buliao.why: What you expected comes first; 不料 starts the surprising second half.

h6-buliao.ch: 我不料他会来参加我的生日会。
h6-buliao.fix: 我没有想到他会来参加我的生日会。
h6-buliao.en: I never thought he'd come to my birthday party.
h6-buliao.why: 不料 can't take a subject like 我 in front; use 没有想到.

h6-buliao.ch: 大家都说这家饭店很好吃，不料我们去的时候已经关门了。
h6-buliao.en: Everyone said the place was great, but when we got there it had closed.
h6-buliao.why: 不料 starts the clause with the unexpected result.

h6-buliao.en: He meant to take a taxi home, but the traffic was jammed.
h6-buliao.why: 不料 goes at the head of the surprising clause.

h6-buman-ni-shuo.en: To be honest with you, I was crying all last night.
h6-buman-ni-shuo.why: 不瞒你说 = "I won't hide it from you": a private confession follows.

h6-buman-ni-shuo.en: To tell you the truth, I can't swim at all.
h6-buman-ni-shuo.why: 不瞒你说 opens the sentence, then comes the thing you admit.

h6-buman-ni-shuo.ch: 不瞒你说，一年有十二个月。
h6-buman-ni-shuo.fix: 不瞒你说，我到现在还不会用电脑。
h6-buman-ni-shuo.en: To be honest, I still can't use a computer.
h6-buman-ni-shuo.why: It introduces something personal you'd normally keep quiet, not a plain fact.

h6-buman-ni-shuo.ch: 不瞒你说，这件衣服是我花五十块买的。
h6-buman-ni-shuo.en: I'll be honest — I only paid fifty yuan for this top.
h6-buman-ni-shuo.why: A small secret about yourself is just what 不瞒你说 introduces.

h6-buman-ni-shuo.en: Truth is, I knew about this a week ago.
h6-buman-ni-shuo.why: 不瞒 goes right before 你说.

h6-bushi.ch: 他一边做作业，一边__看看手机。
h6-bushi.en: While doing his homework, he kept glancing at his phone every so often.
h6-bushi.why: 不时 means now and then, at short irregular gaps.

h6-bushi.en: Every so often he glanced at his watch.
h6-bushi.why: 不时 goes after the person and before the verb.

h6-bushi.ch: 我每个月不时去一次银行。
h6-bushi.en: I go to the bank once a month.
h6-bushi.why: A fixed schedule isn't "now and then", so 不时 doesn't fit.

h6-bushi.ch: 晚上，楼下不时有人走过。
h6-bushi.en: At night, people walk past downstairs every now and then.
h6-bushi.why: People passing at irregular moments is exactly 不时.

h6-bushi.en: During class she kept glancing at the door.
h6-bushi.why: 不时 goes right before the verb it repeats.

h6-buwu.ch: 他的建议__道理，我们可以考虑一下。
h6-buwu.en: His suggestion has a point; we can think about it.
h6-buwu.why: 不无道理 = "has some sense in it": two negatives make a mild yes.

h6-buwu.en: This failure is partly down to poor preparation.
h6-buwu.why: 跟 A 不无关系 = partly connected with A.

h6-buwu.en: What you say has a point.
h6-buwu.why: 不无 takes a two-syllable noun like 道理, not a one-syllable adjective.

h6-buwu.ch: 对于这个结果，他不无担心。
h6-buwu.en: He's somewhat worried about this result.
h6-buwu.why: 不无担心 means there's some worry — a careful way to admit it.

h6-buwu.en: The child's poor grades have something to do with the parents.
h6-buwu.why: 不无 goes right before 关系.

h6-buyoude.ch: 证据都在这里，__你不承认。
h6-buyoude.en: The evidence is all here — you have no choice but to admit it.
h6-buyoude.why: Only 不由得 can go before the person to mean "leaves you no choice".

h6-buyoude.en: As soon as he walked into the room, he couldn't help getting nervous.
h6-buyoude.why: 不由得 goes before the reaction that happens by itself.

h6-buyoude.ch: 我下个月不由得要去北京出差。
h6-buyoude.fix: 我下个月要去北京出差。
h6-buyoude.en: I'm going to Beijing on business next month.
h6-buyoude.why: 不由得 is an instant reaction, not a plan.

h6-buyoude.ch: 他的汉语说得非常好，不由得你不佩服。
h6-buyoude.en: His Chinese is so good you can't help admiring him.
h6-buyoude.why: 不由得 + person + 不 + verb: you have no choice but to.

h6-buyoude.en: Looking at Mum's grey hair, I couldn't help feeling sad.
h6-buyoude.why: 不由得 goes after the person, before the feeling.

h6-chengji.ch: 妈妈出去买菜了，孩子__看起了电视。
h6-chengji.en: Mum went out to buy food, so the child seized the chance to watch TV.
h6-chengji.why: 乘机 stands alone before the verb; 趁 would need a condition after it.

h6-chengji.en: With the teacher out, he took the chance to check his phone.
h6-chengji.why: The situation comes first; 乘机 goes before what he did with it.

h6-chengji.ch: 出差到北京，我乘机会去看了老朋友。
h6-chengji.fix: 出差到北京，我乘机去看了老朋友。
h6-chengji.en: On a business trip to Beijing, I took the chance to see an old friend.
h6-chengji.why: 乘机 already contains 机(会), so don't add 会.

h6-chengji.ch: 商店打折，她乘机买了很多东西。
h6-chengji.en: The shop had a sale, so she took the chance to buy loads.
h6-chengji.why: The sale is the chance; 乘机 + verb says she used it.

h6-chengji.en: The manager was in a good mood, so I took the chance to ask for a raise.
h6-chengji.why: 乘机 goes after the person and before the action.

h6-da.en: It's the dead of winter — why aren't you wearing a coat?
h6-da.why: 大 + time word + 的 stresses that time before a complaint.

h6-da.en: It's boiling hot — why are you still in thick clothes?
h6-da.why: 大热天的 opens the sentence; the complaint follows.

h6-da.ch: 大白天的，阳光真好，我们去公园吧。
h6-da.fix: 大白天的，你怎么还不起床？
h6-da.en: It's the middle of the day — why aren't you up yet?
h6-da.why: 大 + time word leads to a complaint that something doesn't fit that time.

h6-da.ch: 大过年的，别说这些不高兴的话。
h6-da.en: It's New Year — let's not talk about unhappy things.
h6-da.why: 大过年的 stresses the festive time before a gentle telling-off.

h6-da.en: At midday like this, who goes out running?
h6-da.why: 大 goes right before the time word: 这大中午的.

h6-dabuliao.ch: 别担心，这次输了，__下次再来。
h6-dabuliao.en: Don't worry — if we lose this time, at worst we'll try again next time.
h6-dabuliao.why: 大不了 names the worst case to show it's not so bad.

h6-dabuliao.en: Losing your job is no big deal.
h6-dabuliao.why: 没有什么大不了的 = it's no big deal.

h6-dabuliao.ch: 这件事情很大不了，你快想想办法。
h6-dabuliao.fix: 这件事情很严重，你快想想办法。
h6-dabuliao.en: This is serious — think of something quick.
h6-dabuliao.why: As an adjective 大不了 is used in the negative; for "serious" say 严重.

h6-dabuliao.ch: 票卖完了也没关系，大不了明天再走。
h6-dabuliao.en: It's fine if the tickets are sold out — worst case, we leave tomorrow.
h6-dabuliao.why: 大不了 + worst outcome calms things down.

h6-dabuliao.en: Not enough money? No problem — at worst we'll buy a bit less.
h6-dabuliao.why: 大不了 opens the clause with the worst outcome.

h6-dada.ch: 用了新方法，出错的次数__减少了。
h6-dada.en: Since we started the new method, mistakes have dropped a lot.
h6-dada.why: Only 大大 can go straight before a verb of change like 减少.

h6-dada.en: This event greatly boosted the company's income.
h6-dada.why: 大大 goes right before the verb of change.
大大 is for verbs of change, not for likes and feelings.

h6-dada.ch: 有了新规定，迟到的学生大大减少了。
h6-dada.en: Since the new rule, far fewer students are late.
h6-dada.why: 减少 is a verb of change, so 大大 fits.

h6-dada.en: Mobile phones have changed people's lives enormously.
h6-dada.why: 大大 goes before the verb 改变.

h6-yuanyuan.ch: 这次来的人__超过了我们的想象。
h6-yuanyuan.en: Far more people came than we'd imagined.
h6-yuanyuan.why: 远远 stresses a big gap before 超过.

h6-yuanyuan.en: We have nowhere near enough time.
h6-yuanyuan.why: 远远 goes before 不够.

h6-yuanyuan.ch: 这家商店的东西远远便宜。
h6-yuanyuan.fix: 这家商店的东西便宜得多。
h6-yuanyuan.en: Things in this shop are much cheaper.
h6-yuanyuan.why: 远远 needs a verb like 超过 or 不够; after a bare adjective use 得多.

h6-yuanyuan.ch: 我远远地听到有人在叫我的名字。
h6-yuanyuan.en: From far off, I heard someone calling my name.
h6-yuanyuan.why: 远远地 + 听到 says it came from a distance.

h6-yuanyuan.en: Far more phones sold this month than last month.
h6-yuanyuan.why: 远远 goes right before 超过.

h6-dang.ch: 这件事情你最好__跟他说清楚，别发短信。
h6-dang.en: You'd better tell him this face to face, not by text.
h6-dang.why: 当面 = to someone's face; it goes before 跟 + person.

h6-dang.en: He agreed to our request there and then.
h6-dang.why: 当场 comes before the verb, like any adverb.

h6-dang.en: I want to apologise to him in person.
h6-dang.why: 当面 is an adverb, so the person needs 向 / 跟 / 对.

h6-dang.ch: 票只能当天用，第二天就不能用了。
h6-dang.en: The ticket's only good for that day — you can't use it the next.
When the match ended, he got the prize money on the spot.
h6-dang.why: 当场 goes after the person and before the verb.

h6-daoburu.ch: 与其在这儿等出租车，__走路回去。
h6-daoburu.en: Rather than waiting here for a taxi, we'd be better off walking back.
h6-daoburu.why: 与其 A，倒不如 B: the better choice comes after 倒不如.

h6-daoburu.en: Instead of watching TV at home every day, you'd be better off going out for a walk.
h6-daoburu.why: The option you drop follows 与其; the better one follows 倒不如.
tpy: tiān tiān zài jiā kàn diàn shì

h6-daoburu.ch: 你的手机太旧了，买个新的，倒不如修理一下。
h6-daoburu.fix: 你的手机太旧了，修理一下，倒不如买个新的。
h6-daoburu.en: Your phone is so old — rather than repairing it, you'd be better off buying a new one.
h6-daoburu.why: The better choice must come after 倒不如; for an old phone that's buying new.

h6-daoburu.ch: 在这里等他，倒不如直接去他家找他。
h6-daoburu.en: Rather than waiting for him here, we might as well go straight to his place.
h6-daoburu.why: The dropped idea comes first, the better one after 倒不如.

h6-daoburu.en: Rather than going round in circles on your own, just ask the teacher.
h6-daoburu.why: 倒不如 opens the second clause with the better choice.

h6-a-de-a-b-de-b.ch: 下课了，同学们走__走，玩的玩。
h6-a-de-a-b-de-b.en: Class is over: some students leave, some stay and play.
h6-a-de-a-b-de-b.why: Each verb repeats with 的 in between: 走的走 = those who leave, leave.

h6-a-de-a-b-de-b.ch: 这些西瓜大的大，__的小，价格也不一样。
h6-a-de-a-b-de-b.en: These watermelons come in all sizes, and the prices differ too.
h6-a-de-a-b-de-b.why: The same word goes on both sides of 的: 小的小.

h6-a-de-a-b-de-b.ch: 周末大家看书看书，睡觉睡觉。
h6-a-de-a-b-de-b.fix: 周末大家看书的看书，睡觉的睡觉。
h6-a-de-a-b-de-b.en: At the weekend, some people read and some sleep.
h6-a-de-a-b-de-b.why: Each pair needs 的 in the middle: 看书的看书.

h6-a-de-a-b-de-b.ch: 晚上，家里人洗碗的洗碗，看电视的看电视。
h6-a-de-a-b-de-b.en: In the evening, some of the family wash up and some watch TV.
h6-a-de-a-b-de-b.why: Two pairs of V 的 V paint everyone doing their own thing.

h6-a-de-a-b-de-b.en: These students are all different — some tall, some short.
h6-a-de-a-b-de-b.why: 的 goes between the two 高: 高的高.

h6-de-yaoming.en: After moving house all day, I'm dead tired.

h6-de-yaoming.why: With an object, say the verb again: 想家想得要命.
要命 already says "extremely", so drop 很.

h6-de-yaoming.ch: 肚子疼得要命，我一点儿也不想吃东西。
h6-de-yaoming.en: My stomach hurts terribly — I don't feel like eating anything.
h6-de-yaoming.why: 得要命 is mostly used for pain and discomfort.

h6-de-yaoming.en: The metro is terribly crowded — there isn't a single seat.
h6-de-yaoming.why: 要命 comes right after 得.

h6-deyi.ch: 明天有空的话，我__去看你。
h6-deyi.en: If I'm free tomorrow, I can come and see you.
h6-deyi.why: An everyday plan takes 可以; 得以 looks back on what became possible.
终于 + 得以 + two-syllable verb reports the result.

h6-deyi.ch: 我下午得以去超市买水果。
h6-deyi.fix: 我下午可以去超市买水果。
h6-deyi.en: I can go to the supermarket for fruit this afternoon.
h6-deyi.why: 得以 isn't for everyday plans; use 可以.

h6-deyi.ch: 经过三年的研究，这个问题才得以解决。
h6-deyi.en: Only after three years of research was the problem solved.
h6-deyi.why: The reason comes first; 才得以 + verb says it finally became possible.

h6-deyi.en: Thanks to the police, the lost child was able to get home.
h6-deyi.why: 得以 goes after 才 and right before the verb.

h6-dong-xi.ch: 他在超市里东看看__看看，什么也没有买。
h6-dong-xi.en: He looked all around the supermarket but didn't buy anything.
h6-dong-xi.why: 东 V 西 V: the same verb after both 东 and 西.

h6-dong-xi.en: Books are scattered all over the room — what a mess.
h6-dong-xi.why: 东一本西一本: 东 comes first, then 西, each with 一 + measure word.

h6-dong-xi.en: He searched all over the room.
h6-dong-xi.why: The same verb must follow both 东 and 西.

h6-dong-xi.ch: 周末我们在公园里东走走西走走，特别有意思。
h6-dong-xi.en: At the weekend we wandered all over the park — it was great fun.
h6-dong-xi.why: 东走走西走走 = wandering here and there.

h6-dong-xi.en: He didn't know the way, so he asked around along the road.
h6-dong-xi.why: 东 goes before the first verb, 西 before the second.

h6-dongbudong.ch: 我儿子动不动__要买新玩具。
h6-dongbudong.en: My son wants a new toy at the slightest excuse.
h6-dongbudong.why: 动不动 almost always comes with 就.

h6-dongbudong.en: Stop getting angry over every little thing.

h6-dongbudong.ch: 她动不动就给妈妈做好吃的。
h6-dongbudong.fix: 她经常给妈妈做好吃的。
h6-dongbudong.en: She often cooks nice things for her mum.
h6-dongbudong.why: 动不动 complains about bad habits; for a good one use 经常.

h6-dongbudong.ch: 这个孩子身体不好，动不动就感冒。
h6-dongbudong.en: This child isn't strong and catches a cold at the drop of a hat.
h6-dongbudong.why: Catching colds too easily is a bad habit, so 动不动就 fits.

h6-dongbudong.en: My boss makes us work overtime at the slightest excuse.
h6-dongbudong.why: 动不动 goes after the person, before 就.

h6-dui-eryan.ch: 对学生__，最重要的是学习。
h6-dui-eryan.en: For students, studying is what matters most.
h6-dui-eryan.why: 对 + person + 而言 = as far as they're concerned.

h6-dui-eryan.en: For many old people, mobile phones are too complicated.
h6-dui-eryan.why: 对 … 而言 wraps the person and opens the sentence.

h6-dui-eryan.ch: 对我来说而言，周末是休息的时间。
h6-dui-eryan.fix: 对我而言，周末是休息的时间。
h6-dui-eryan.en: For me, the weekend is time to rest.
h6-dui-eryan.why: 而言 and 来说 do the same job; use only one.

h6-dui-eryan.ch: 对这个小城市而言，这次比赛非常重要。
h6-dui-eryan.en: For this small city, this competition matters a lot.
h6-dui-eryan.why: 对 … 而言 gives the point of view.

h6-dui-eryan.en: For new graduates, experience matters more than pay.
h6-dui-eryan.why: 而言 closes the 对 … phrase, before the comma.

h6-dunshi.en: Don't worry, I'll be there right away.
h6-dunshi.why: A promise takes 马上; 顿时 only describes a sudden change that already happened.

h6-dunshi.en: Hearing what the doctor said, he felt relieved at once.
h6-dunshi.why: The event comes first; 顿时 goes before the new state.

h6-dunshi.en: Everyone, please be quiet right now.
h6-dunshi.why: 顿时 can't give an order; use 马上.

h6-dunshi.ch: 太阳一出来，天气顿时暖和了。
h6-dunshi.en: As soon as the sun came out, it warmed up at once.
h6-dunshi.why: A sudden change after an event is just what 顿时 describes.

h6-dunshi.en: The moment she walked in, the children all burst out laughing.
h6-dunshi.why: 顿时 goes after the subject, before the change.

h6-duoduoshaoshao.ch: 学习了两年汉语，他__能听懂一些。
h6-duoduoshaoshao.en: After two years of Chinese, he can understand a bit, more or less.
h6-duoduoshaoshao.why: 多多少少 = to some degree; it softens the statement.

h6-duoduoshaoshao.en: I'm partly responsible for this, more or less.
h6-duoduoshaoshao.why: 多多少少 comes before 有点儿.

h6-duoduoshaoshao.ch: 你们班有多多少少学生？
h6-duoduoshaoshao.en: How many students are in your class?
h6-duoduoshaoshao.why: The doubled form isn't a question word; to ask "how many" use 多少.

h6-duoduoshaoshao.ch: 搬到新地方，多多少少会有点儿不习惯。
h6-duoduoshaoshao.en: When you move somewhere new, you're bound to feel a little out of place.
h6-duoduoshaoshao.why: 多多少少 + 会有点儿: at least a bit.

h6-duoduoshaoshao.en: You've got an exam tomorrow — at least do a bit of reading.
h6-duoduoshaoshao.why: Here 多多少少 nudges: do at least a little.

h6-eryi.ch: 我只是开个玩笑__，你别生气。
h6-eryi.en: I was only joking — don't be angry.
h6-eryi.why: 而已 closes the sentence to play it down: only this, nothing more.
不过 goes up front and 而已 at the very end.

h6-eryi.en: I'm just looking, I'm not buying.
h6-eryi.why: 而已 goes at the very end; 只是 goes before the verb.

h6-eryi.ch: 这件衣服才一百块而已，不算贵。
h6-eryi.en: This top is only a hundred yuan — not expensive.
h6-eryi.why: 才 … 而已 plays the price down.

h6-eryi.en: I'm just a bit tired, that's all — don't worry.
h6-eryi.why: 而已 closes the part it plays down.

h6-fan.ch: 经过一__努力，他终于找到了满意的工作。
h6-fan.en: After a lot of effort, he finally found a job he's happy with.
h6-fan.why: 番 counts a bout of effort, talk or thought.

h6-fan.en: He gave the room a good clean.
h6-fan.why: 一番 comes after the verb for a whole bout of effort.

h6-fan.en: I had a bowl of soup at lunch.
h6-fan.why: 番 is for effort, words and thought, not food and drink.

h6-fan.ch: 五年来，这个城市的人口翻了一番。
h6-fan.en: Over five years, this city's population has doubled.
He took real care getting dressed up before going out.
h6-fan.why: 番 follows 一 after the verb: 打扮了一番.

h6-fanzhi.ch: 努力就会进步，__就会落后。
h6-fanzhi.en: Work hard and you'll improve; if not, you'll fall behind.
h6-fanzhi.why: 反之 = if the opposite is true, then …

h6-fanzhi.en: Rest well and you feel good; if not, you feel bad.
h6-fanzhi.why: The rule comes first; 反之 turns it round.

h6-fanzhi.ch: 哥哥很高，反之弟弟很矮。
h6-fanzhi.en: The older brother is tall, but the younger one is short.
h6-fanzhi.why: 反之 flips a condition; a plain "whereas" takes 却.

h6-fanzhi.ch: 心情好，做事情效率就高；反之，效率就低。
h6-fanzhi.en: In a good mood you work efficiently; otherwise, you don't.
h6-fanzhi.why: 反之 gives the flip side of the rule.

h6-fanzhi.en: When goods are scarce, prices are high; when not, prices are low.
h6-fanzhi.why: 反之 opens the second half, after the first rule.

h6-gai-ganma-ganma.ch: 你身体刚好，该休息__休息，别去上班了。
h6-gai-ganma-ganma.en: You've only just got better — rest when you should, and don't go to work.
h6-gai-ganma-ganma.why: The frame is 该 + verb + 就 + the same verb.

h6-gai-ganma-ganma.en: Go on, get on with whatever you should be doing.
h6-gai-ganma-ganma.why: 该 comes first, then 干吗 twice: 该干吗干吗.

h6-gai-ganma-ganma.en: It's fine — just carry on as usual.
h6-gai-ganma-ganma.why: 该 comes first, then 干吗 is said twice.

h6-gai-ganma-ganma.ch: 周末到了，大家该干吗干吗，别再想工作了。
h6-gai-ganma-ganma.en: It's the weekend — everyone get on with your lives and stop thinking about work.
h6-gai-ganma-ganma.why: 该干吗干吗 = do what you'd normally do.

h6-gai-ganma-ganma.en: Rain doesn't matter — everyone carry on as normal.
h6-gai-ganma-ganma.why: 该 goes right before the first 干吗.

h6-a-gui-a.why: A 归 A grants one thing, then says it doesn't change another.

h6-a-gui-a.en: Playing is fine, but homework still has to be finished.

h6-a-gui-a.ch: 虽然工作归工作，但是也要照顾家里。

h6-a-gui-a.ch: 生气归生气，他还是把我的电脑修理好了。
h6-a-gui-a.en: Angry or not, he still fixed my computer for me.
h6-a-gui-a.why: 生气归生气 grants he was angry, then says he still helped.

h6-a-gui-a.en: Friends are friends, but I still have to point out mistakes at work.
h6-a-gui-a.why: 归 goes between the two 朋友.

h6-guigendaodi.ch: 我们等了半个小时，公共汽车__来了。
h6-guigendaodi.en: We waited half an hour, and the bus finally came.
h6-guigendaodi.why: "At last" is 终于; 归根到底 names a root cause.

h6-guigendaodi.en: The child doesn't like studying — at root, he just isn't interested.
h6-guigendaodi.why: 归根到底 goes right before 是 + root cause.

h6-guigendaodi.ch: 归根到底，我们终于到了北京。

h6-guigendaodi.en: After ten hours on the plane, we finally reached Beijing.

h6-guigendaodi.ch: 身体好不好，归根到底还是看生活习惯。
h6-guigendaodi.en: Whether you're healthy comes down, in the end, to your habits.
h6-guigendaodi.why: 归根到底 + 还是 names the bottom line.

h6-guigendaodi.en: The company has grown fast, and at root it's because it has good people.
h6-guigendaodi.why: 归根到底 comes before 是因为 + the real reason.

h6-guoyu.en: The food at this restaurant is so good!

h6-guoyu.en: Don't trust what other people say too much.

h6-guoyu.ch: 这个电影过于精彩，我看了三遍。

h6-guoyu.en: This film is so good I've seen it three times.

h6-guoyu.ch: 家长对孩子过于严格，也不一定对孩子好。
h6-guoyu.en: Parents being too strict isn't necessarily good for their kids.
h6-guoyu.why: 过于严格 = stricter than is right — a criticism.

h6-guoyu.en: He's overcautious, which actually makes him more likely to slip up.
h6-guoyu.why: 过于 goes right before the adjective.

h6-guqie.en: I'll accept your excuse for now, but don't be late again.

h6-guran.ch: 大城市的机会固然多，__生活压力也大。
h6-guran.en: Big cities offer more chances, sure, but life there is more stressful.
h6-guran.why: 固然 grants a point, then 但是 turns.

h6-guran.en: This method is good, admittedly, but it takes too much time.
h6-guran.why: 固然 comes right after the subject; 可是 starts the turn.

h6-guran.ch: 学习固然辛苦，因此我们要多休息。
h6-guran.fix: 学习固然辛苦，但是也很有意思。
h6-guran.en: Studying is hard work, sure, but it's also a lot of fun.
h6-guran.why: 固然 sets up a turn (但 / 可) or an "also" (也), not a result.

h6-guran.ch: 自己做菜固然麻烦，可是比饭店的干净。
h6-guran.en: Cooking for yourself is a hassle, admittedly, but it's cleaner than restaurant food.
h6-guran.why: 固然 agrees with A, then 可是 turns to B.

h6-guran.en: Work matters, of course, but family matters more.
h6-guran.why: 固然 goes right after the subject.

h6-henbude.ch: 表演的时候忘记了要说什么，我__马上消失。

h6-henbude.why: 恨不得 is a burning wish you can't really act on.

h6-henbude.en: I wish a day had forty-eight hours.
h6-henbude.why: 恨不得 goes before the (impossible) wish.

h6-he-xiangbi.ch: 和十年以前相比，这里的变化大__了。
h6-he-xiangbi.en: Compared with ten years ago, this place has changed a lot.
h6-he-xiangbi.why: After 和 … 相比, measure the gap with 多了 / 一些, not 很.

h6-he-xiangbi.en: Compared with his classmates, he's much more mature.
h6-he-xiangbi.why: 和 + yardstick + 相比 comes first; the main clause follows.

h6-he-xiangbi.ch: 和我姐姐相比，我很瘦了。
h6-he-xiangbi.fix: 和我姐姐相比，我瘦多了。
h6-he-xiangbi.en: Compared with my older sister, I'm much thinner.
h6-he-xiangbi.why: A comparison takes 多了 / 一些 / 更, not 很.

h6-he-xiangbi.ch: 跟以前相比，现在买东西方便多了。
h6-he-xiangbi.en: Compared with the past, shopping is much easier now.
h6-he-xiangbi.why: 跟 … 相比 sets the yardstick; 多了 measures the difference.

h6-he-xiangbi.en: Compared with the north, winters in the south are a bit warmer.
h6-he-xiangbi.why: 相比 closes the 和 … phrase.

h6-huanjuhuashuo.ch: 他是我妈妈的哥哥，__，他是我舅舅。

h6-huanjuhuashuo.ch: 我喜欢看书，__，我也喜欢听音乐。
h6-huanjuhuashuo.en: I like reading; I also like listening to music.

h6-huanjuhuashuo.ch: 他会游泳，换句话说，他也会打篮球。
h6-huanjuhuashuo.fix: 他会游泳，另外，他也会打篮球。
h6-huanjuhuashuo.en: He can swim, and he can play basketball too.
h6-huanjuhuashuo.why: Basketball is a new point, not a rewording, so use 另外.

h6-huanjuhuashuo.ch: 这次考试没有及格，换句话说，下次还要再参加一次考试。
h6-huanjuhuashuo.en: I failed this exam — in other words, I'll have to sit it again.

h6-huanjuhuashuo.en: We only have three days — in other words, it must be done by Friday.
h6-huanjuhuashuo.why: 换句话说 sits between the idea and its rewording.

h6-shier.en: His voice goes high, then low.
h6-shier.why: 时而 A，时而 B describes two states taking turns.

h6-shier.en: During the match he switched between attacking and defending.
h6-shier.why: The first 时而 goes after the subject, matching the second one.

h6-shuliang-chongdie.ch: 请大家不要着急，__地进去。
h6-shuliang-chongdie.en: No rushing, everyone - go in one at a time.
h6-shuliang-chongdie.why: "One at a time" before a verb is 一个一个(地); 个个 means "each and every".

h6-shuliang-chongdie.en: Every one of the students is happy.
h6-shuliang-chongdie.why: 个个 comes after the group and before 都.

h6-shuliang-chongdie.ch: 请大家个个把护照拿出来。
h6-shuliang-chongdie.fix: 请大家一个一个地把护照拿出来。
h6-shuliang-chongdie.en: Everyone, please take out your passports one at a time.
h6-shuliang-chongdie.why: 个个 only means "every one"; for one after another, say 一个一个.

h6-shuliang-chongdie.ch: 我们把这些椅子一个一个地搬上去吧。
h6-shuliang-chongdie.en: Let's carry these chairs up one at a time.
h6-shuliang-chongdie.why: 一 M 一 M + 地 before a verb means one after another.

h6-shuliang-chongdie.en: These kids are clever, every one of them.
h6-shuliang-chongdie.why: 个个 follows the group it describes and comes before 都.

h6-shuo.ch: 他这个人脾气不好，__生气就生气。
h6-shuo.en: He's got a temper - he flares up in an instant.
h6-shuo.why: 说 V 就 V says it happens the moment it's mentioned.

h6-shuo.en: He just upped and left, without even taking his things.
h6-shuo.why: The frame is 说 + V + 就 + V, with the same verb twice.
tpy: dōng xi dōu méi yǒu dài

h6-shuo.ch: 这个孩子说哭才哭，谁都没有办法。
h6-shuo.fix: 这个孩子说哭就哭，谁都没有办法。
h6-shuo.en: This kid bursts into tears at the drop of a hat - nobody can do a thing about it.
h6-shuo.why: The frame is 说 V 就 V: 就 says it happens at once. 才 would mean 'not until'.

h6-shuo.ch: 现在的年轻人说辞职就辞职。
h6-shuo.en: Young people these days quit their jobs on a whim.
h6-shuo.why: 说 V 就 V with the same verb, 辞职, on both sides.

h6-shuo.en: This kid bursts out laughing at the drop of a hat - so cute.
h6-shuo.why: 说 opens the frame: 说笑就笑.

h6-suiji.ch: 你__过来一下，我有事情找你。
h6-suiji.en: Come over here right now - I need you for something.
h6-suiji.why: For requests and orders use 马上; 随即 only reports what already happened.

h6-suiji.en: The boss read the report and immediately texted the manager.
h6-suiji.why: Action 1 first, then 随即 + the action that followed right after.

h6-suiji.ch: 你到家随即给我打电话。
h6-suiji.fix: 你到家马上给我打电话。
h6-suiji.en: Call me as soon as you get home.
h6-suiji.why: 随即 can't be used for requests; say 马上.

h6-suiji.ch: 门一开，一只小猫随即冲了出去。
h6-suiji.en: The moment the door opened, a kitten shot out.
h6-suiji.why: Two past events, the second straight after the first - that's 随即.

h6-suiji.en: The match ended, and the crowd left straight away.
h6-suiji.why: 随即 goes after the subject, before the second action.

h6-suozai.ch: 找到了问题__，就容易解决了。
h6-suozai.en: Once you find where the problem lies, it's easy to fix.
h6-suozai.why: After 问题, 所在 means "where it really lies".

h6-suozai.en: The school she's at isn't far from here.
h6-suozai.why: 所在的 describes the noun that follows it: 她所在的学校.
所在 isn't a verb; to say where someone is, use plain 在.

h6-suozai.ch: 这正是他成功的原因所在。
h6-suozai.en: That's exactly the reason he succeeded.
h6-suozai.why: 原因 + 所在: where the real reason lies.

h6-suozai.en: Please write down the city where you live.
h6-suozai.why: 所在 goes between the person and 的 + noun: 你所在的公司.

h6-teyi.ch: 他__把水倒在我的书上，还笑。
h6-teyi.en: He poured water on my book on purpose, and then laughed.
h6-teyi.why: Doing something bad on purpose is 故意; 特意 is for kind, planned acts.

h6-teyi.en: Mum made a whole table of dishes just for me.
h6-teyi.why: 特意 comes before 给 + person + verb.

h6-teyi.ch: 他特意撞了我一下，然后就走了。
h6-teyi.fix: 他故意撞了我一下，然后就走了。
h6-teyi.en: He bumped into me on purpose and then just walked off.
h6-teyi.why: A mean act done on purpose takes 故意, not 特意.

h6-teyi.ch: 知道你要来，我特意多买了一些水果。
h6-teyi.en: I knew you were coming, so I bought some extra fruit specially.
h6-teyi.why: A kind act planned for someone - that's 特意.

h6-teyi.en: I took a day off specially to go to the hospital with Mum.
h6-teyi.why: 特意 goes after the subject, before the planned action.

h6-tonghong.en: The kid's nose has gone bright red with cold.
h6-tonghong.why: 通红 already means "very red", so it never takes 很 or 非常.

h6-tonghong.en: She was so shy her whole face went red.
h6-tonghong.why: Verb + 得 + 满脸通红: the red face is the result.

h6-tonghong.en: His eyes were red from crying.
h6-tonghong.why: Drop 很 - 通红 already contains "very".

h6-tonghong.ch: 他在太阳下站了一天，脸晒得通红。
h6-tonghong.en: He stood in the sun all day, and his face got burnt bright red.
h6-tonghong.why: Verb + 得 + 通红, with no 很 in front.

h6-tonghong.en: He was so excited his face went bright red, and he just stood there smiling.
h6-tonghong.why: 通红 follows the noun it describes: 脸通红.

h6-xuebai.en: These sheets have been washed snowy white.
h6-xuebai.why: To make 雪白 stronger, repeat the whole word; 雪雪白白 isn't a form, and 很 doesn't fit.
雪白的 describes the noun that follows it.
雪白 already means "very white"; strengthen it by doubling, not with 很.

h6-xuebai.ch: 她的牙齿雪白雪白的，很好看。
h6-xuebai.en: Her teeth are pearly white - lovely.
h6-xuebai.why: The whole word doubles - 雪白雪白的 - with no 很.

h6-xuebai.en: Mum washed the clothes snowy white.
h6-xuebai.why: The doubled form is 雪白雪白的, after 洗得.

h6-tongtong.en: All of you - out, every last one!
h6-tongtong.why: 统统 means all of them, none left; 一共 and 总共 are for adding up numbers.

h6-tongtong.en: He threw away everything on the table.
h6-tongtong.why: The things come first; 统统 goes before the verb phrase that covers them.

h6-tongtong.en: I've read every one of these books.
h6-tongtong.why: Like 都, 统统 covers what comes before it, so put the books in front.

h6-tongtong.ch: 今天的作业他统统做完了。
h6-tongtong.en: He's done every bit of today's homework.
h6-tongtong.why: The group (作业) comes first, then 统统 + verb.

h6-tongtong.en: He threw out every one of his old clothes.
h6-tongtong.why: With 把, the things come first and 统统 goes right before the verb.

h6-weidu.ch: 别的菜我都爱吃，__不吃羊肉。
h6-weidu.en: I'll eat any other dish - only not lamb.
h6-weidu.why: 唯独 picks out the one exception after a statement about the whole group.

h6-weidu.en: The whole family went - only Grandpa stayed at home.
h6-weidu.why: First the whole group, then 唯独 + the one exception.

h6-weidu.ch: 唯独多练习，才能说好汉语。
h6-weidu.fix: 只有多练习，才能说好汉语。
h6-weidu.en: Only by practising a lot can you speak Chinese well.
h6-weidu.why: "Only if" is 只有……才……; 唯独 just singles out an exception.

h6-weidu.ch: 他什么运动都喜欢，唯独不喜欢游泳。
h6-weidu.en: He likes every sport except swimming.
h6-weidu.why: Everything else, then 唯独 + the single thing that's different.

h6-weidu.en: Everyone's free this weekend except me - I have to work overtime.
h6-weidu.why: 唯独 goes right before the exception, 我.

h6-weimian.ch: 第一次见面，__会有点儿紧张。
h6-weimian.en: It's natural to be a bit nervous the first time you meet.
h6-weimian.why: "Bound to happen" is 难免; 未免 criticises something as "a bit too".

h6-weimian.en: You're a bit too blunt when you talk.
h6-weimian.why: 未免 comes before 太 + adjective.

h6-weimian.ch: 刚到一个新地方，未免会觉得不习惯。
h6-weimian.fix: 刚到一个新地方，难免会觉得不习惯。
h6-weimian.en: When you've just arrived somewhere new, you're bound to feel a bit out of place.
h6-weimian.why: This is something bound to happen, so it takes 难免, not the critical 未免.

h6-weimian.ch: 为了一块钱吵架，未免太不值得了。
h6-weimian.en: Arguing over one yuan really isn't worth it.
h6-weimian.why: 未免 + 太 softly says it goes too far.

parts: 才学习了一个月就想当翻译，
h6-weimian.en: Wanting to be an interpreter after one month of study is a bit hasty of you.
h6-weimian.why: 未免 goes after the subject and before 有点儿.

h6-wei-qijian.ch: 为__起见，我们还是再检查一遍吧。
h6-wei-qijian.en: Just to be safe, let's check it once more.
h6-wei-qijian.why: Only abstract aims like 保险 or 安全 fit in 为……起见, never a person.

h6-wei-qijian.en: For safety's sake, please don't smoke in the room.
h6-wei-qijian.why: 为 + aim + 起见 frames the reason; the precaution follows.
tpy: bú yào zài fáng jiān lǐ chōu yān

h6-wei-qijian.ch: 为了妈妈起见，他搬回了老家。
h6-wei-qijian.fix: 为了妈妈，他搬回了老家。
h6-wei-qijian.en: He moved back to his home town for his mum's sake.
h6-wei-qijian.why: 起见 only follows aims like 安全 or 方便; for a person, just use 为了.

h6-wei-qijian.ch: 为方便起见，我们在地铁站见面吧。
h6-wei-qijian.en: To make it easy, let's meet at the underground station.
h6-wei-qijian.why: 方便 is an abstract aim, so 为方便起见 is right.

h6-wei-qijian.en: For safety's sake, children had better not go out alone.
h6-wei-qijian.why: 起见 closes the frame right after the aim: 为安全起见.

h6-wubi.ch: 我明天__六点起床，要赶飞机。
h6-wubi.en: I have to get up at six tomorrow to catch a flight.
h6-wubi.why: 务必 is for urging others; for your own obligation, 必须 is natural.

h6-wubi.en: Please be sure to keep this to yourself.
h6-wubi.why: 请 + 务必 + verb: a firm, polite request.

h6-wubi.ch: 我务必每天八点到公司。
h6-wubi.fix: 我必须每天八点到公司。
h6-wubi.en: I have to be at the office at eight every day.
h6-wubi.why: Your own duty takes 必须; 务必 urges someone else.

h6-wubi.en: The roads are slippery - please do be careful.
h6-wubi.why: 请务必 + verb is a firm, polite request to someone else.

h6-wubi.en: Tomorrow, please be sure to bring your passport.
h6-wubi.why: 务必 comes after 请 and right before the verb.

h6-wubu.ch: 看到这个消息，大家__吃惊。
h6-wubu.en: Everyone, without exception, was shocked by the news.
h6-wubu.why: 无不 means "none who didn't" - everyone; 无非 is "nothing more than".

h6-wubu.en: Everyone who took part in the event praised it.
h6-wubu.why: The group comes first, then 无不 + verb.
tpy: zhè cì huó dòng de rén

h6-wubu.ch: 大家无不都称赞他的勇气。
h6-wubu.fix: 大家无不称赞他的勇气。
h6-wubu.why: 无不 already means "all", so it doesn't take 都.

h6-wubu.ch: 看过这本书的人，无不被书中的故事感动。
h6-wubu.en: Everyone who has read this book is moved by its story.
h6-wubu.why: Group + 无不 + reaction: every reader, no exception.

h6-wubu.en: Everyone there was proud of her.
h6-wubu.why: 无不 goes right after the group it covers.

h6-wufei.ch: 他说了半天，__是想让你借钱给他。
h6-wufei.en: For all his talk, he just wants you to lend him money.
h6-wufei.why: 无非 plays it down: it's nothing more than this.

h6-wufei.en: I only wanted to remind you, that's all.
h6-wufei.why: 无非 (是) + the thing, with 而已 at the end for "that's all".

h6-wufei.ch: 看过这场比赛的人无非很激动。
h6-wufei.fix: 看过这场比赛的人无不激动。
h6-wufei.en: Everyone who watched the match was thrilled.
h6-wufei.why: "Everyone without exception" is 无不; 无非 means "just, only".

h6-wufei.ch: 他每天做的无非就是上班、下班、玩手机。
h6-wufei.en: All he does every day is go to work, come home and play on his phone.
h6-wufei.why: 无非就是 makes his day sound small - nothing beyond that.

h6-wufei.en: They only ever argue about money.
h6-wufei.why: 无非 comes before 是 + the thing it plays down.

h6-xian.en: Grandma always thinks I don't eat enough.
h6-xian.why: 嫌 + person + 太 + fault: she's unhappy because it's too little.

h6-xian.en: She thought this top was too expensive, so she didn't buy it.
He finds this job too tiring.
h6-xian.why: 嫌 needs the fault named - too tiring, too far, too noisy.

h6-xian.ch: 你要是不嫌麻烦，就给我带一个面包吧。
h6-xian.en: If it's no trouble, could you bring me a bread roll?
h6-xian.why: 不嫌 + fault is a friendly "if you don't mind".

h6-xian.en: Some customers find this place too far from the underground.
h6-xian.why: 嫌 comes after the person and before what they're unhappy about.

h6-xianglai.en: I've never been to the south.
h6-xianglai.why: "Have never done" with 过 takes 从来; 向来 describes habits and traits.

h6-xianglai.en: She's always been warm towards people, and everyone likes her.
h6-xianglai.why: 向来 goes after the subject, before the long-standing trait.
tpy: dà jiā dōu xǐ huan tā

h6-xianglai.why: For "have never done" with 过, use 从来.

h6-xianglai.ch: 他向来说到做到，你可以相信他。
h6-xianglai.en: He's always done what he says - you can trust him.
h6-xianglai.why: 向来 describes a trait that has held all along.

h6-xianglai.en: People in our family have always been careful with money.
h6-xianglai.why: 向来 goes after the subject (我们家的人), before 很 + adjective.

h6-yijing.en: I'll text you as soon as I get home.
h6-yijing.why: Everyday "as soon as" is 一……就……; 一经 is formal and goes with processes like 发现 or 批准.

h6-yijing.en: Once a mistake is found, it must be put right at once.
h6-yijing.why: 一经 + process verb first, then the result that follows.

h6-yijing.en: He goes swimming as soon as he finishes work.
h6-yijing.why: An everyday routine takes 一……就……; 一经 is for formal processes.

h6-yijing.ch: 这个办法一经试用，就受到了大家的称赞。
h6-yijing.en: As soon as the method was tried out, everyone praised it.
h6-yijing.why: 一经 + a process (试用), then 就 + the result.

h6-yijing.en: Once this rule is approved, it will take effect straight away.
h6-yijing.why: 一经 goes right before the process verb 批准.

h6-yiju.ch: __公司的规定，每个人都要按时上班。
h6-yiju.en: Under company rules, everyone has to be at work on time.
h6-yiju.why: 依据 introduces the rule a requirement is based on; 关于 only names a topic.

h6-yiju.en: The company docked his bonus in line with the rules.
h6-yiju.why: 依据 + rule sits before the action it's based on.

h6-yiju.ch: 依据他，这个电影不好看。
h6-yiju.fix: 在他看来，这个电影不好看。
h6-yiju.en: In his view, this film isn't any good.
h6-yiju.why: 依据 needs a rule or evidence after it, not a person's opinion.

h6-yiju.ch: 这个结论缺乏科学依据。
h6-yiju.en: This conclusion has no scientific basis.
h6-yiju.why: As a noun, 依据 means "grounds, basis".

h6-yiju.en: We'll deal with this according to the contract.
h6-yiju.why: 依据 comes right before the contract it's based on.

h6-yimian.ch: 请提前准备好材料，__耽误时间。
h6-yimian.en: Please get your documents ready beforehand so no time is wasted.
h6-yimian.why: 以免 introduces the bad result you want to avoid; 以便 is "so that" something is easier.

h6-yimian.en: Please switch off your phone in class so you don't disturb others.
h6-yimian.why: What you do comes first; 以免 opens the half with the unwanted result.

h6-yimian.ch: 把重要的东西放好，以免不丢了。
h6-yimian.fix: 把重要的东西放好，以免丢了。
h6-yimian.en: Put your valuables away safely so you don't lose them.
h6-yimian.why: 以免 already means "to avoid"; adding 不 flips the meaning.

h6-yimian.ch: 药要放高一点儿，以免孩子拿到。
h6-yimian.en: Keep the medicine up high so the kids can't get at it.
h6-yimian.why: The bad thing itself follows 以免, with no 不.

h6-yimian.en: Lock the door before bed so no burglar gets in.
h6-yimian.why: 以免 starts the second half, before the unwanted event.

h6-yishi.ch: 这个工作我__不想换，过一段时间再说。
h6-yishi.en: I don't want to change jobs for now - we'll see in a while.
h6-yishi.why: Putting a plan on hold is 暂时; 一时 is for a sudden, short-lived state.

h6-yishi.en: He can't think of a good way just now.
h6-yishi.why: 一时 goes before 想不出: for the moment, he can't.

h6-yishi.ch: 他们一时住在宾馆里，下个月搬家。
h6-yishi.fix: 他们暂时住在宾馆里，下个月搬家。
h6-yishi.en: They're staying in a hotel for now and moving next month.
h6-yishi.why: A temporary arrangement takes 暂时, not 一时.

h6-yishi.ch: 我一时着急，说了不该说的，对不起。
h6-yishi.en: I got flustered for a moment and said something I shouldn't have - sorry.
h6-yishi.why: 一时 blames a slip on the heat of the moment.

h6-yishi.en: His name escapes me for the moment.
h6-yishi.why: 一时 goes after the subject, before 想不起来.

h6-yi-wei.ch: 这次活动以孩子为__，大人只是来帮忙的。
h6-yi-wei.en: This event is all about the children - the adults are only here to help.
h6-yi-wei.why: The set piece is 以……为中心 (centred on).

h6-yi-wei.en: She's always had becoming an interpreter as her goal.
h6-yi-wei.why: 以 + A + 为 + B: 以当翻译为目标.

h6-yi-wei.en: We all look up to him as a role model.
h6-yi-wei.why: 以 pairs with 为; 当 belongs with spoken 把……当.

h6-yi-wei.ch: 学校以培养人才为目标。
h6-yi-wei.en: The school's goal is to train talented people.
h6-yi-wei.why: 以……为目标 is one of the set pieces: aim for …
以 goes before A, and 为 before B: 以他为骄傲.

h6-yizhi.ch: 她太激动了，__一个字也说不出来。
h6-yizhi.en: She was so moved she couldn't say a word.
h6-yizhi.why: After an extreme cause, 以至 gives the result it led to.

h6-yizhi.en: He played games for so long that his eyes went red.
h6-yizhi.why: The cause comes first; 以至 opens the result half.

h6-yizhi.ch: 以至他太忙了，连周末都在工作。
h6-yizhi.fix: 他太忙了，以至连周末都在工作。
h6-yizhi.en: He's so busy that he even works at weekends.
h6-yizhi.why: 以至 opens the result half, not the cause.

h6-yizhi.ch: 他的变化太大了，以至我差点儿不认识他了。
h6-yizhi.en: He's changed so much I almost didn't recognise him.
h6-yizhi.why: 太 + adjective sets up the cause; 以至 brings in how far it went.

parts: 我们听不清楚对方说话。
h6-yizhi.en: The music was so loud we couldn't hear each other.
h6-yizhi.why: 以至 starts the result clause, after the cause.

h6-youguan.en: His failure has to do with his personality.
h6-youguan.why: A 跟 B 有关 = A has to do with B; 关于 only introduces a topic.

h6-youguan.en: Please hand the relevant documents to me.
h6-youguan.why: Before a noun, 有关 means "relevant".

h6-youguan.ch: 他的成绩有关他的学习态度。
h6-youguan.fix: 他的成绩跟他的学习态度有关。
h6-youguan.en: His results have to do with his attitude to study.
h6-youguan.why: The related thing goes between 跟 / 与 and 有关, not after it.

h6-youguan.ch: 这件事情与我无关，别问我。
h6-youguan.en: This has nothing to do with me - don't ask me.
h6-youguan.why: The negative of 与……有关 is 与……无关.

h6-youguan.en: I've already reported this to the relevant department.
h6-youguan.why: 有关 goes right before the noun: 有关部门.

h6-youru.en: My brother and I look very alike.
h6-youru.why: Everyday "look alike" is 像; 犹如 is a literary word for images.

h6-youru.en: Those days were like a beautiful dream.
h6-youru.why: A + 犹如 + B: a vivid, written comparison.

h6-youru.en: He looks like his older brother.
h6-youru.why: For everyday "looks like", use 像; 犹如 is literary.

h6-youru.ch: 那天的月亮圆得犹如一个盘子。
h6-youru.en: The moon that night was as round as a plate.
h6-youru.why: A descriptive image - just where 犹如 belongs.

h6-youru.en: To me, this book is like an old friend.
h6-youru.why: 犹如 goes between the thing (这本书) and what it's compared to.

h6-ge-geshi.ch: 这几天下雨下__不停，我们只好在家里。
h6-ge-geshi.en: It's been raining non-stop these past few days, so we've had to stay in.
h6-ge-geshi.why: Verb + 个 + 不停: here 个 isn't counting, so there's no 一.

h6-ge-geshi.en: The holidays are here - I'm going to have a great time.
h6-ge-geshi.why: 个 sits between the verb and how far it goes: 玩个痛快.
In this pattern 个 isn't counting anything, so drop the 一.

h6-ge-geshi.ch: 有什么不明白的，你可以去问个清楚。
h6-ge-geshi.en: If anything's unclear, go and get it cleared up.
h6-ge-geshi.why: Verb + 个 + 清楚: get to the bottom of it.

h6-ge-geshi.en: Today you can eat until you're full!
h6-ge-geshi.why: 个 goes between the verb and the result: 吃个饱.

h6-yuxian.ch: 考试__了一个星期，大家都很紧张。
h6-yuxian.en: The exam has been moved a week earlier, and everyone's nervous.
h6-yuxian.why: "Moved earlier" is the verb 提前; 预先 only goes before another verb.

h6-yuxian.en: We bought the cinema tickets in advance.
h6-yuxian.why: 预先 goes right before the verb.

h6-yuxian.ch: 他的航班预先了半个小时。
h6-yuxian.fix: 他的航班提前了半个小时。
h6-yuxian.en: His flight was brought forward by half an hour.
h6-yuxian.why: 预先 can't be the verb itself; for "moved earlier", use 提前.

h6-yuxian.ch: 为了这次会议，我们预先做了很多准备。
h6-yuxian.en: We prepared a lot beforehand for this meeting.
h6-yuxian.why: 预先 + verb: done before the event, to be ready.

h6-yuxian.en: Before the show, they rehearsed many times in advance.
h6-yuxian.why: 预先 goes after the subject, right before the verb.

h6-yu-yu.en: The more I read this book, the more I like it.
h6-yu-yu.why: 愈……愈…… already says "more and more", so no 很 or 最 after it.

h6-yu-yu.en: His Chinese is getting more and more fluent.
h6-yu-yu.why: 愈来愈 goes right before the adjective, just like 越来越.
愈来愈 already means "more and more", so drop 很.

h6-yu-yu.ch: 他愈解释，大家愈不相信。
h6-yu-yu.en: The more he explains, the less people believe him.
h6-yu-yu.why: 愈 A，愈 B works just like 越……越……, only more bookish.

h6-yu-yu.en: The more he thought about it, the angrier he got.
h6-yu-yu.why: The first 愈 goes before the first verb: 愈想愈生气.

h6-zanqie.ch: 这只是__的困难，大家不要担心。
h6-zanqie.en: This is only a temporary difficulty - don't worry, everyone.
h6-zanqie.why: Before a noun (的困难) use 暂时; 暂且 only goes before a verb.

h6-zanqie.en: Forget everything else for now - let's get to the hospital first.
h6-zanqie.why: 暂且 + (不) + verb: put it on hold for now.
暂且 can't describe a noun; "temporary" before a noun is 暂时.

h6-zanqie.ch: 新家还没有装修好，我们暂且住在爸爸妈妈家。
h6-zanqie.en: Our new place isn't done up yet, so we're staying with my parents for now.
h6-zanqie.why: 暂且 + verb: a stopgap until later.

h6-zanqie.en: Put work aside for now and get some proper rest.
h6-zanqie.why: 暂且 goes right before the verb it puts on hold.

h6-zhene.ch: 你别看这个菜不贵，味道好__。
h6-zhene.en: This dish may be cheap, but it tastes really good.
h6-zhene.why: Adjective + 着呢 says "really quite …, believe me".

h6-zhene.en: It's really cold up north - take more clothes.
h6-zhene.why: 着呢 comes straight after the adjective.
tpy: duō dài diǎn r yī fu

h6-zhene.why: 着呢 already adds the "really", so drop 很.

h6-zhene.ch: 你别小看她，她厉害着呢。
h6-zhene.en: Don't underestimate her - she's seriously good.
h6-zhene.why: Adjective + 着呢, with no 很 in front.

h6-zhene.en: It's a long way along this road - let's take a taxi.
h6-zhene.why: 着呢 goes right after the adjective 远.

h6-zhishi.ch: 老师的鼓励__我对学习有了信心。
h6-zhishi.en: The teacher's encouragement gave me confidence in my studies.
h6-zhishi.why: A good result takes 使; 致使 is for bad results.

h6-zhishi.en: His carelessness caused the whole plan to fail.
h6-zhishi.why: Cause + 致使 + thing + bad result.

h6-zhishi.ch: 他的努力致使他获得了冠军。
h6-zhishi.fix: 他的努力使他获得了冠军。
h6-zhishi.en: His hard work won him the championship.
h6-zhishi.why: 致使 is only for bad results; a good outcome takes 使 or 让.

h6-zhishi.ch: 经常熬夜致使他的身体越来越差。
h6-zhishi.en: Staying up late all the time has made his health worse and worse.
h6-zhishi.why: A cause leading to a bad result - formal 致使.

h6-zhishi.en: That driver was going too fast, which left three people injured.
h6-zhishi.why: 致使 links the cause to the bad result that follows.

h6-zhong.ch: 我在洗衣服__，你等我一会儿。
h6-zhong.en: I'm doing the washing - wait a moment.
h6-zhong.why: Everyday "I'm doing …" is 在……呢; V + 中 is formal, for processes like 讨论.
正在 + two-syllable verb + 中: formal "in progress".

h6-zhong.ch: 我在洗澡中，你过一会儿再给我打电话。
h6-zhong.fix: 我在洗澡呢，你过一会儿再给我打电话。
h6-zhong.en: I'm in the shower - call me back in a bit.
h6-zhong.why: For an everyday activity use 在……呢, not the formal V + 中.
A formal process (建设) + 中, typical of notices and news.

h6-zhong.en: The matter is still being studied and can't be announced yet.
h6-zhong.why: 中 goes right after the verb: 在研究中.

h6-zhongjiu.ch: 我们找了三天，__找到了那只小猫。
h6-zhongjiu.en: We searched for three days and at last found the kitten.
h6-zhongjiu.why: "At last" after waiting or searching is 终于.

h6-zhongjiu.en: He's your father, after all - stop arguing with him.
h6-zhongjiu.why: 终究 + 是 stresses what someone basically is.

h6-zhongjiu.ch: 等了一个小时，终究等到出租车了。
h6-zhongjiu.fix: 等了一个小时，终于等到出租车了。
h6-zhongjiu.en: After waiting an hour, I finally got a taxi.
h6-zhongjiu.why: For "at last" after waiting, use 终于.

h6-zhongjiu.ch: 你骗得了别人，但是终究骗不了自己。
h6-zhongjiu.en: You can fool other people, but in the end you can't fool yourself.
h6-zhongjiu.why: 终究 states how things finally turn out.

h6-zhongjiu.en: He'll understand you in the end.
h6-zhongjiu.why: 终究 goes after the subject, before 会.

h6-zhu.ch: 我们要逐__解决这些问题。
h6-zhu.en: We need to deal with these problems one by one.
h6-zhu.why: 逐 joins straight onto a one-syllable unit: 逐个.

h6-zhu.en: We need to change this situation step by step.
h6-zhu.why: 逐步 goes right before the verb.

h6-zhu.fix: 警察逐个问了在场的人。
h6-zhu.en: The police questioned everyone there one by one.
h6-zhu.why: 逐 needs a unit after it (个, 条, 年); it can't go straight before a verb.

h6-zhu.ch: 这些年，来这里旅游的人逐年增加。
h6-zhu.en: In recent years, the number of tourists here has grown year by year.
h6-zhu.why: 逐 + 年 makes an adverb that goes right before the verb.

h6-zhu.en: We went through these issues point by point.
h6-zhu.why: 逐 goes right before the unit: 逐条.

h6-zuo-you.en: I waited and waited, but he just didn't show up.
h6-zuo-you.why: The order is fixed: 左 first, then 右.

h6-zuo-you.en: She tried on one thing after another and finally bought a top.
h6-zuo-you.why: 左 V 右 V: 左 comes first, then 右, with the same verb.

h6-zuo-you.ch: 我右想左想，还是不明白。
h6-zuo-you.fix: 我左想右想，还是不明白。
h6-zuo-you.en: I thought it over and over and still didn't get it.
h6-zuo-you.why: The order is fixed: 左 first, then 右.

h6-zuo-you.ch: 妈妈左一个短信，右一个短信，催我回家。
h6-zuo-you.en: Mum sent one text after another telling me to come home.
h6-zuo-you.why: 左一个……右一个…… stresses "one after another".

h6-zuo-you.en: I searched high and low but couldn't find the keys.
h6-zuo-you.why: 右 comes second, before the repeated verb: 左找右找.

h6-zuyi.ch: 我们的时间还__，不用着急。
h6-zuyi.en: We've still got enough time - no need to rush.
h6-zuyi.why: 足以 must be followed by a verb; to say "there's enough", use 够.

h6-zuyi.en: This evidence is enough to prove he wasn't lying.
h6-zuyi.why: 足以 goes right before the verb 证明.

h6-zuyi.ch: 这些面包足以了，别买了。
h6-zuyi.en: That's enough bread - don't buy any more.
h6-zuyi.why: 足以 needs a verb after it; "that's enough" on its own is 够.

h6-zuyi.ch: 这点儿钱不足以买一台电脑。
h6-zuyi.en: This bit of money isn't enough to buy a computer.
h6-zuyi.why: 不足以 + verb: not enough to do it.

h6-zuyi.en: This alone shows how responsible he is.
h6-zuyi.why: 足以 goes right before the verb 说明.
